input: Find bootstrapped European vertical SaaS companies for logistics or freight with 50-200 employees

companies.name: Riege Software
companies.employees: 51–200 employees; Tracxn reports this range as of 2024-12-31 (profile last updated 2026-11-05). Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/riege/__NIaoVEJiYVqV7ZAxK0T5kPX5kl3ZE7oqkDH_-DFfkwI

criteria_evidence.evidence: Tracxn classifies Riege as unfunded and says it has not raised any funding rounds yet. This is consistent with Riege's own statement that it has been privately held ever since its 1985 founding.
The company profile lists Riege as based in Meerbusch, Germany; Riege's press page identifies the company as headquartered in Germany.

criteria_evidence.criterion: Vertical SaaS for logistics or freight
criteria_evidence.evidence: Riege describes Scope as cloud-based software for air freight, sea freight and customs. Tracxn describes Riege as providing software solutions for freight forwarding and logistics.
Tracxn reports an employee count of 51–200 as of 2024-12-31.
Riege says five second-generation siblings jointly run the family business and that the company remains in family hands; the company also says it has been privately held since 1985.

companies.headcount_growth: Tracxn observation: 51–200 employees as of 2024-12-31; the same 51–200 range remained on the profile updated 2026-11-05. This supports continued fit within the target band but does not establish growth within the band. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/riege/__NIaoVEJiYVqV7ZAxK0T5kPX5kl3ZE7oqkDH_-DFfkwI
companies.last_round: No external funding round disclosed: Tracxn says Riege has not raised any funding rounds and classifies it as unfunded, as of the profile updated 2026-11-05. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/riege/__NIaoVEJiYVqV7ZAxK0T5kPX5kl3ZE7oqkDH_-DFfkwI
companies.traction: Riege says its Scope software is used by more than 900 companies in 60 countries, as of 2026-07-29. Source: https://www.riege.com/company/press/press-releases/riege-software-names-christian-riege-as-new-ceo
companies.rank_reason: Highest fit because the opened sources verify every core criterion: European HQ, freight-forwarding/cloud TMS product, 51–200 employees, unfunded status, and family ownership. Its strongest traction signal is more than 900 customer companies across 60 countries.

output.search_notes: Only one company was returned because the criteria were kept strict. Riege Software is the only opened profile I could verify as both unfunded and family-owned while also meeting the European logistics/freight vertical-SaaS and 50–200 employee requirements. FleetGO was excluded: the opened 2026 transaction page says Main Capital Partners invested in it in 2022 and later sold it to Aptean, so it is not a bootstrapped, non-PE-owned target. Source: https://www.private-equitynews.com/news/main-capital-partners-exits-pan-european-logistics-software-provider-fleetgo-group/
